title: ABBOTT LABORATORIES 8-K Filing — Q1 2026 Results
summary: Abbott Laboratories filed an 8-K on April 16, 2026 announcing Q1 2026 operating results. The filing incorporates a press release (Exhibit 99.1) with non-GAAP financial measures excluding specified items, intangible amortization, and other adjustments. The company uses non-GAAP metrics to provide visibility into ongoing business performance.
key_points: Abbott Laboratories reported Q1 2026 results on April 16, 2026 per Item 2.02 (Results of Operations and Financial Condition)
Filing includes non-GAAP financial measures adjusting for acquisition-related expenses, stock-based compensation, restructuring costs, and tax items
Non-GAAP measures exclude intangible amortization expense to assess ongoing business performance
Press release attached as Exhibit 99.1 and incorporated by reference
8-K signed by CFO Philip P. Boudreau on behalf of Abbott Laboratories
